title: Why Sleep Helps You Remember
titleZh: 為什麼睡覺能幫你記憶
subtitle: 熬夜苦讀反而記不住？從記憶研究看考前該怎麼睡

sentences.en: Many students believe that staying up all night is the most efficient way to prepare for an exam.
sentences.zh: 很多學生認為，熬夜整晚是準備考試最有效率的方法。

highlights.note: 「熬夜到天亮」，動名詞當主詞子句的主詞。

examples.en: I stayed up late to finish my report.
examples.zh: 我熬夜把報告寫完。

examples.en: Taking the train is more efficient.
examples.zh: 搭火車比較有效率。

chunks.text: Many students believe
that staying up all night
is the most efficient way to prepare for an exam.
chunks.zh: 是準備考試最有效率的方法。

sentences.en: Research on memory, however, suggests almost exactly the opposite.
sentences.zh: 然而，關於記憶的研究顯示的幾乎正好相反。

highlights.note: 插在句中的 however 前後要加逗號，表示轉折。

examples.en: He did the opposite of what I said.
examples.zh: 他做的跟我說的完全相反。

examples.en: The results suggest a clear link.
examples.zh: 結果顯示有明確的關聯。

sentences.en: When you learn something new during the day, your brain stores it only temporarily, a bit like a draft saved on a desktop.
sentences.zh: 當你白天學了新東西，大腦只是暫時儲存它，有點像存在桌面上的草稿。

examples.en: The shop is temporarily closed.
examples.zh: 這家店暫停營業。

examples.en: The app stores your photos online.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式把你的照片存在網路上。

examples.en: Send me your first draft.
examples.zh: 把你的初稿寄給我。

grammar.quote: a draft saved on a desktop
grammar.explanation: saved on a desktop 是被動意義的分詞片語，修飾 draft（= a draft which is saved）。

examples.en: I found a letter written by my grandfather.
examples.zh: 我找到一封我祖父寫的信。

grammar.pitfall: 不要寫成 a draft save on，要用過去分詞。

chunks.text: When you learn something new during the day,
your brain stores it only temporarily,
a bit like a draft saved on a desktop.
chunks.zh: 有點像存在桌面上的草稿。

sentences.en: It's during sleep, especially deep sleep, that much of this information is moved into long-term memory.
sentences.zh: 正是在睡眠中，尤其是深層睡眠時，這些資訊很多才會被移到長期記憶裡。

highlights.text: It's during sleep, especially deep sleep, that
highlights.note: 強調句型 It is ... that，強調「正是在睡眠時」。

examples.en: Sleep helps build long-term memory.
examples.zh: 睡眠有助於建立長期記憶。

examples.en: He was in a deep sleep.
examples.zh: 他睡得很熟。

grammar.quote: It's during sleep, especially deep sleep, that
grammar.explanation: It is + 被強調部分 + that + 句子其他部分，用來強調時間、地點或人。

examples.en: It was in Tainan that I first tried milkfish.
examples.zh: 我是在台南第一次吃到虱目魚。

grammar.pitfall: 被強調的是人時可用 who，但時間地點仍用 that，不要改成 when 或 where。

chunks.text: It's during sleep,
especially deep sleep,
that much of this information is moved into long-term memory.
chunks.zh: 這些資訊很多才被移進長期記憶。

sentences.en: In one well-known type of experiment, volunteers learn a list of word pairs in the evening.
sentences.zh: 在一種有名的實驗中，自願受試者在晚上背一串成對的單字。

examples.en: The study needed fifty volunteers.
examples.zh: 這項研究需要五十位自願者。

examples.en: We did an experiment in chemistry class.
examples.zh: 我們在化學課做了一個實驗。

connected.note: list 的 t 和 of 連讀，of 弱讀成 /ə/。

sentences.en: Half of them sleep normally, while the other half are kept awake.
sentences.zh: 一半的人正常睡覺，另一半的人則被要求保持清醒。

examples.en: The coffee kept me awake all night.
examples.zh: 咖啡讓我整晚睡不著。

grammar.quote: while the other half are kept awake
grammar.explanation: while 在這裡不是「當……時」，而是表示對比「而、然而」。

examples.en: I like tea, while my brother likes coffee.
examples.zh: 我喜歡茶，而我哥哥喜歡咖啡。

grammar.pitfall: 表對比的 while 前通常加逗號，不要和表時間的 while 搞混。

sentences.en: The next day, the group that slept usually remembers noticeably more, even though both groups studied for the same amount of time.
sentences.zh: 隔天，有睡覺的那組通常記得明顯比較多，即使兩組讀書的時間一樣長。

examples.en: The room was noticeably colder.
examples.zh: 房間明顯變冷了。

examples.en: We spent the same amount of time on it.
examples.zh: 我們花在上面的時間一樣多。

chunks.text: The next day,
the group that slept usually remembers noticeably more,
chunks.zh: 有睡覺的那組通常記得明顯比較多，

chunks.text: even though both groups studied for the same amount of time.
chunks.zh: 即使兩組讀書的時間一樣長。

sentences.en: Sleep also seems to help the brain connect ideas, which is why a problem can feel easier after a good night's rest.
sentences.zh: 睡眠似乎也能幫助大腦連結各種想法，這就是為什麼一個問題在好好睡一晚後會感覺比較簡單。

highlights.note: 「一夜好眠」，所有格表示「一晚的」。

examples.en: Try to connect the new words with pictures.
examples.zh: 試著把新單字和圖片連結起來。

grammar.quote: which is why a problem can feel easier
grammar.explanation: which is why 承接前面整句，意思是「這就是為什麼……」，用來說明結果。

examples.en: She trains every day, which is why she's so fast.
examples.zh: 她每天訓練，這就是她那麼快的原因。

grammar.pitfall: which is why 前面要加逗號，因為 which 指的是前面整句話。

chunks.text: Sleep also seems to help the brain connect ideas,
chunks.zh: 睡眠似乎也能幫大腦連結想法，

chunks.text: which is why a problem can feel easier
chunks.zh: 這就是為什麼一個問題會感覺比較簡單，

chunks.text: after a good night's rest.

connected.note: night's 的 s 和 rest 的 r 連在一起，聽起來很快。

sentences.en: On the other hand, after a sleepless night, attention drops, reactions slow down, and mistakes become far more likely.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，一夜沒睡之後，注意力會下降、反應變慢，出錯的機率也高很多。

examples.en: I had a sleepless night before the interview.
examples.zh: 面試前一晚我失眠了。

examples.en: Please pay attention to the screen.
examples.zh: 請注意螢幕。

examples.en: Rain is likely this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午可能會下雨。

chunks.text: On the other hand,
after a sleepless night,
attention drops, reactions slow down,
and mistakes become far more likely.

sentences.en: So if you have a test tomorrow, a better plan is to review in short sessions, test yourself, and then go to bed at a reasonable hour.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你明天有考試，比較好的計畫是分成幾段短時間複習、自我測驗，然後在合理的時間上床睡覺。

highlights.note: 主動回想比重讀筆記更能加深記憶。

examples.en: We had a two-hour study session.
examples.zh: 我們讀了兩個小時的書。

examples.en: Please call at a reasonable hour.
examples.zh: 請在合理的時間打電話。

chunks.text: So if you have a test tomorrow,
chunks.zh: 所以如果你明天有考試，

chunks.text: a better plan is to review in short sessions,
chunks.zh: 比較好的計畫是分段短時間複習，

chunks.text: test yourself,
and then go to bed at a reasonable hour.
chunks.zh: 然後在合理的時間上床睡覺。

connected.note: test 的 t 和 yourself 的 y 結合成 /tʃ/。

sentences.en: Sleep is not time taken away from studying; it is part of studying.
sentences.zh: 睡覺不是從讀書時間裡被偷走的時間，而是讀書的一部分。

highlights.note: 結論句：把睡眠視為學習的一環。

examples.en: Phones take away time from sleep.
examples.zh: 手機佔掉了睡眠時間。

grammar.quote: not time taken away from studying; it is part of studying
grammar.explanation: 分號連接兩個意思緊密的獨立子句，前句否定、後句給出正確說法。

examples.en: It isn't a problem; it's a chance to learn.
examples.zh: 這不是問題，而是學習的機會。

grammar.pitfall: 分號後面不需要大寫，也不要再加 and。
